definition: Not fitting naturally or harmoniously with surrounding things.
book: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: It was the curse of mankind that these incongruous fagots were thus bound together that in the agonised womb of consciousness, these polar twins should be continuously struggling.
example_sentence: A neon sign looked incongruous on the thatched cottage.
